cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. I spent the first ten seconds finding the race.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'
